Package io.mavlink4j.codec

Interface SigningPolicy

public interface SigningPolicy
Decides whether a decoded frame is dispatched, given its origin sysid and SignatureStatus. Lives in mavlink-core, not the adapter layer, specifically so a future per-vehicle "signing required" mode is a different SigningPolicy supplied by the host, not a change to the library.

Implementer contract: accept(int, io.mavlink4j.codec.SignatureStatus) runs on the receive thread for every decoded frame; it must be fast, stateless or thread-safe, and never throw. By convention a policy never accepts SignatureStatus.INVALID.

PERMISSIVE is the default implementation: it accepts everything except a genuinely bad signature. SignatureStatus.INVALID is dropped under every policy this module will ever define, PERMISSIVE included -- a bad signature is never "prefer to accept anyway" (see the signing spec).
